title: Finite and infinite subsets
statement: Fix universes as in [def-weil-size-convention]. For a set $A$, $A$ is finite when it has finitely many elements, and $A$ is infinite when it is not finite; these are the Mathlib predicates $A.\operatorname{Finite}$ and $A.\operatorname{Infinite}$.
